question: to the Commission Daniel Freund (Verts/ALE) Subject:

In response to Written Question E-002773/20251, the Commission provided a detailed breakdown of all payments made to Hungary between December 2022 and May 2025. In this context, can the Commission provide an updated and comprehensive overview of all disbursements of EU funds to Hungary since December 2022, including the respective amounts transferred, the precise dates on which the respective payments were executed and the specific budget lines from which the transfers were made?
Answer to Written Question E-002773/2025, ‘EU funds paid to Hungary – clarification of disbursement dates’, https://www.europarl.europa.eu/doceo/document/E-10-2025-002773-ASW_EN.html.
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (26.5.2026) The Honourable Member may find in the annex a more detailed breakdown of the payments, including the respective amounts transferred and the precise dates on which the respective payments were transferred to Hungary, per budget line and multiannual financial framework programme for the period between December 2022 and December 2025.
